_comment: QID -> canonical display name overrides for the Screen of the Metros pipeline. Consulted when Wikidata english-label resolution fails and would otherwise emit a raw QID (e.g. 'Q873') as a person's name in screen.json. Seeded 2026-07-25 after 19 person QIDs leaked into screen.json (People/Directors tables + metro 'top figure' cards). The annual _screen_of_metros_pipeline rebuild should look names up here BEFORE writing any person 'name' field, and should hard-fail (or log) rather than emit a bare Q-id if a name is still unresolved.
